test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: By selling an article for Rs. 2,340, the dealer loses 10% At what price should he sell the article to gain 15%?
solution:
**Given:**

SP of an article = Rs. 2,340

Loss = 10%

Gain = 15%

**Formula used:**

SP = CP × [(100 – Loss%)/100]

SP = CP × [(100 + Gain%)/100]

**Calculation:**

According to the question

SP = CP × [(100 – Loss%)/100]

⇒ 2,340 = CP × [(100 – 10)/100]

⇒ 2,340 = CP × 90/100

⇒ CP = (2,340 × 100/90)

⇒ CP = Rs. 2,600

New SP = (2,600 × 115/100)

⇒ Rs. 2,990

**∴ The required SP is Rs. 2,990**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** Let CP be 100%

So, SP if loss% is 10 = 90%

Now,

⇒ 90% = Rs. 2,340

Then,

⇒ 115% = Rs. (2,340 × 115/90)

⇒ Rs. (26 × 115)

⇒ 2,990

**∴ The required SP is Rs. 2,990**
